source: As Sam ran through the forest, surrounded by giant ironwood trees and some sparse underbrush, he couldn’t help but get a little nervous.
target: Dum Sam per silvam currebat, ingentibus arboribus ligni ferrei et rara subboscitate circumdatus, paulum anxius fieri non potuit.

source: The first obstacle for the quest was a monster that he had no hope of defeating.
target: Primum obstaculum expeditionis erat monstrum, quod vincere nullam spem habebat.

source: He imagined that if a player with a guild got it, they would be still there, trying to figure out how to win against the boss.
target: Existimabat, si lusor cum collegio id adeptus esset, ibi mansurum esse, conans invenire modum quomodo contra ducem vinceretur.

source: "I wonder how long it would take them to consider talking with the monster…" he mused as he tried to find that one specific tree that the old ranger told him about while ignoring the cricket on his head.
target: "Quamdiu illi de colloquio cum monstro cogitare poterint, miror," meditatus est, dum illam unicam arborem quaerebat, de qua senex custos eum certiorem fecit, neglegens gryllum in capite suo.

source: Who, for some reason, was humming.
target: Qui, quadam ratione, murmure leni sonabat.

source: He slowed down, throttling his speed back from an all‑out sprint to a leisurely jog as his head was on a swivel, trying to spot a literal tree in the forest.
target: Celeritatem retraxit, recedens ex totali cursu ad lenem ambulandi modum, dum caput circumversum, arborem veram in silva quaerebat.

source: Sam slowed to walk and then engaged all his sensory skills.
target: Sam ambulare tardavit et deinde omnes facultates sensoriae suas adhibuit.

source: According to the old man, the tree had a symbol on it, and it probably still contained some mana, which would help him find it.
target: Secundum senem, arbor signum habebat, et probabiliter adhuc aliquam manam contineret, quae ei auxilium afferret ad eam inveniendam.

source: Slowly, his walk stopped, and he stood at the edge of a regular clearing, with closed eyes and his senses stretched to the limits.
target: Paulatim iter eius cessavit, et stetit in limine spatii aperti, oculis clausis atque sensibus ad limites extensis.

source: Trying to spot a minuscule amount of a very specific concentration of mana.
target: Conans perscrutari minutam quantitatem peculiarem manae concentrationis.

source: With a giant cricket on his head that was still humming.
target: Cum ingenti gryllo in capite, qui adhuc murmure leni sonabat.

source: He felt the mana in the air, in the trees, in the vegetation and in the ground.
target: Sentivit manam in aere, in arboribus, in vegeto, et in terra.

source: He felt as great clumps of mana moved around – animals and monsters – mostly away from him and his impromptu passenger.
target: Sensit ingentes agmina manae circumire – animalia atque monstra – plerumque ab eo et socio fortuito secedentes.

source: Sam at first excluded the ground, slowly but surely twisting his senses so that the information that came back to him didn’t tell him anything about the ground he stood on.
target: Sam initio terram excludebat, sensus suos lente sed certo torquens, ut notitia redeunte nihil de terra in qua staret referret.

source: With that, he had more mana available to gather information about the rest of the targets.
target: Ex hoc, maiorem manam habebat ad colligendam notitiam de reliquis obiectis.

source: He slowly wound the mana in a pattern that somehow made sense, and in an instant, the monsters and animals vanished from his senses.
target: Lente manam in ordinem versavit, qui aliquam rationem exprimebat, et in momento, monstra atque animalia ex sensibus eius evanuerunt.

source: Then Sam took a little breather, waiting for his reserves to fill up, trying to find his objective but coming up short.
target: Deinde Sam paulum respiravit, exspectans ut copia eius replearentur, conans propositum suum invenire, sed sufficere non potuit.

source: Not at all perturbed, he continued with his manipulations of the skill.
target: Non perturbatus, manipulationibus artis suae perseveravit.

source: Mana moved upon his command and was twisted into shapes which were further linked together, in turn creating bigger shapes.
target: Mana, mandato eius, movebatur et in figuras convolutas versa est, quae ulterius inter se coniunctae erant, creantes formas maiores.

source: It was almost beyond his ability to coherently describe it to anybody else.
target: Fere ultra posse eius erat, ut id alicui alii cohaerenter enarraret.

source: The mana manipulation was such a unique and, most importantly, alien sense that even years into the future people would struggle to adequately define it to anybody who didn’t use it.
target: Manipulatio manae erat tam singularis et, maximi momenti, aliena, ut etiam annos postea homines luctarent ut id alicui, qui id non utebatur, apte definirent.

source: Not to mention those who went beyond what the skills in the game provided and tried to manipulate the very mana in the game.
target: Nisi etiam eos qui extra limites artium ludi proficiebantur et ipsam manam manipulare conabantur.

source: There were rumors, but it was said that more than one person went mad due to the phenomenon.
target: Rumores erant, sed dicebatur non uno tantum homine ex hoc phaenomeno insanire.

source: He ignored all those feelings, fully focusing on the mana and the feedback it was providing.
target: Neglexit illa omnia sensa, totus in manam atque in responsionem quam praebebat intendens.

source: The ground and the fauna were already excluded, so the next thing on his to‑do list was the underbrush and any other vegetation that wasn’t a tree.
target: Terra et fauna iam excluduntur, itaque proximo in ordine operum eius erant subboscus et quaedam alia vegetatio, quae arbor non erant.

source: Slowly, the Mana Sense skill cohered into a new shape and the only thing he could ‘see’ with his mind’s eye were the giant trees towering over them.
target: Paulatim, ars “Sensus Manae” in novam formam coniuncta est, et unica quae mente videre poterat erant ingentes arbores, quae super omnes se extollere videbantur.

source: Unfortunately, he was in a forest where there were a lot of trees.
target: Infeliciter, in silva erat, ubi multae arbores erant.

source: Thankfully, he had an answer to that.
target: Bene est quod responsum illi haberet.

source: Carefully extending his hand, Sam touched the nearest tree, one of the famous ironwoods, and channelled a minuscule amount of mana into it.
target: Cautus, manum extendens, Sam arborem proximam tetigit, una ex claris arboribus ligni ferrei, atque minutam quantitatem manae in eam infundit.

source: He delicately circulated the mana in the tree, following the veins in it, from the roots to the treetops, to every leaf, then back to his hand, getting familiar with the tree’s mana signature.
target: Arcte manam in arbore circulavit, venas eius secutus, a radicibus ad summitatem, ad omne folium, deinde ad manum suam redeo, signum manae arboris cognoscens.

source: Sam spent a small amount of time getting to know the signature, memorizing it (it was rather simple thanks to it being a tree) then slowly he removed his hand from the tree and returned his focus to his Mana Sense.
target: Sam parvum tempus dedicavit ad signum cognoscendum, id meminens (quod satis simplex erat, ex natura arboris), deinde lente manum a arbore detrahens et in Sensus Manae suum se concentravit.

source: Slowly, using his own mana, he began to construct the mana signature of the ironwood tree into his spell.
target: Lente, sua manā utens, signum manae arboris ligni ferrei in incantationem suam constituere coepit.

source: He failed.
target: Defecit.

source: The spell fizzled out and the Mana Sense with all the filters built into it came crashing down on him, causing him to stagger back cursing in a low voice, while the cricket was chortling on his head, her laughter like bells tinkling.
target: Incantatio exstincta est, et Sensus Manae cum omnibus inclusis filtris super eum ruere coepit, faciens eum retro titubare et sub voce humili maledicere, dum gryllus in capite eius cachinnabat, risus eius quasi tintinnabulorum resonans.

source: He ignored her, then tried it again.
target: Illam neglexit, atque iterum conatus est.

source: First, the exclusion of the ground.
target: Primum, terrae exclusio.

source: Then the animals and monsters.
target: Deinde animalia et monstra.

source: Then the flora.
target: Deinde flora.

source: And finally, he began to construct the mana signature of the ironwood again.
target: Et tandem iterum signum manae arboris ligni ferrei construere coepit.

source: He failed again.
target: Iterum defecit.

source: And again.
target: Et iterum.

source: And again.
target: Et iterum.

source: It was annoying.
target: Id molestum erat.

source: Especially the needling laugh of his unwanted passenger.
target: Praesertim risus aculeus comitis eius inopportuni.

source: So he tried, tried and tried again…
target: Itaque iterum atque iterum conatus est…

source: Two hours later, Sam was mentally exhausted; the cricket was still chortling, and he was on the brink of logging out and going to sleep for days before trying again.
target: Duo horis post, Sam mente exhaustus erat; gryllus adhuc cachinnabat, et ipse ad exitum sistematis atque ad diem somnum capiendum paene erat, antequam iterum conaretur.

source: He knew it was possible.
target: Sciebat id fieri posse.

source: He (or rather the other Sam) read the accounts from the high‑rated mages.
target: Ipse (vel potius alter Sam) relationes a summis magorum legebat.

source: Granted, their explanations at the time made no sense to the other Sam, but to him? It made some sense…
target: Certo, earum explicationes alteri Sam tempore nihil sensu praebebant, sed ei? Aliquid sensum habebat…

source: The shapes of the mana just moved in a way that made sense to him.
target: Formae manae se moverunt modo, qui sensum ei praeberet.

source: Even if his life depended on it, he couldn’t explain how it made sense to him, but it did.
target: Etiamsi vita eius in hoc pendebat, non potuit explanare quomodo illud ei sensum praeberet, sed fere ita erat.

source: Finally, scrounging up his last remaining concentration, he began shaping the mana.
target: Tandem, ultimam quoque attentionem colligens, manam formare coepit.

source: Slowly and carefully, he took hold of each grain of mana, and one after another put them into place.
target: Lente et diligenter, singula grana manae tenuit, et una post aliam in locum posuit.

source: And the shape of the ironwood tree, in the abstract, took shape in his Mana Sense skill.
target: Et forma arboris ligni ferrei, in abstractione, in facultate Sensus Manae eius apparuit.

source: There was no warning, instead, the skill clicked and one moment he could sense all trees and the next only the ironwood trees.
target: Nulla praemonitio fuit; proinde, ars subito instar ictus accedebat, et uno momento omnes arbores sentire poterat, et deinde solum arbores ligni ferrei.

source: Thankfully, he was at the edge of the true ironwood forest, so he wasn’t overwhelmed with choices.
target: Gratias Deo, ad limen verae silvae arborum ligni ferrei erat, itaque non multitudine electionum oppressus est.

source: Quickly, before the very delicate mana construct could shatter, he focused and began looking for the symbol.
target: Celeriter, antequam ipsa tenuis constructio manae discerperetur, se concentravit et signum quaesivit.

source: It was a hidden symbol, used by the rangers of old to denote areas of importance.
target: Erat signum occultum, a veteribus custodibus ad notanda loca momenti adhibitum.

source: The new generation of guardians used the same symbols to protect the areas where the true ironwood trees resided against deforestation.
target: Nova generatio protectorum eadem signa adhibebat ad tuendas regiones, ubi verae arbores ligni ferrei habitabant, contra deforestationem.

source: Occasionally, they ventured there to get a few samples for some important people, but people mostly had to be content with the young forests around Ironwood city.
target: Occasionibus, ad illuc profecti sunt ad paucas probationes pro aliquibus personis gravibus colligendas, sed plerique contenti esse debebant iuvenibus silvis circa urbem Ironwood.

source: Eyes still closed, feeling something on the periphery of his senses, Sam began to slowly walk forward, hands held out to avoid bumping into something.
target: Oculi eius adhuc clausi erant, et aliquid in extremitatibus sensuum sentiens, Sam lente porrexit, manibus protensis ne in aliquam rem incidat.

source: After a few minutes of bumbling, ignoring the cricket’s laughter, he finally arrived at the spot he was aiming for.
target: Post paucas minutas errandi, neglegens risum grylli, tandem ad locum, quem petebat, pervenit.

source: Letting go of the spell, feeling as if a giant weight had been lifted off his body, Sam sighed deeply and opened his eyes.
target: Incantationem dimittens, sentiens quasi ingens pondus ex corpore eius sublatum esset, Sam alte suspiravit et oculos aperuit.

source: The first thing he saw was a giant ironwood tree, covered by moss around the roots, and high up a mysterious symbol, slightly glowing to his Mage Sight.
target: Primum quod vidit, ingens arbor ligni ferrei erat, circa radices musco obtecta, et in altitudine signum mysteriosum, parum lucentem ad visu Magi eius.

source: The second thing was, of course, the notification screens.
target: Secunda res, scilicet, erat tabula notitiarum.

source: [Advanced Mana Control is now Level 15!]
target: [Manae Moderatio Provecta nunc Gradus 15 est!]

source: [Stable Mana Control is now Level 4!]
target: [Manae Moderatio Stabilia nunc Gradus 4 est!]

source: [Thanks to your miraculous effort, Mana Sense has reached Level 25!]
target: [Gratias conatu tuo mirabili, Sensus Manae Gradum 25 attingit!]

source: [Thanks to pushing your senses to their absolute maximum (again), you gained the sub‑skill, Natural Sensor!]
target: [Gratias sensus tuos ad summum terminum iterum impellendis, sub‑artem, Sensor Naturalis, adeptus es!]

source: [Natural Sensor: Level MAX (Passive) You are a natural sensor. Your sensing range, detail and every other attribute are increased. Mana cost of sensing skills is decreased. Grants the Flow skill.]
target: [Sensor Naturalis: Gradus MAX (Passivus) Tu es sensor naturalis. Ambitus sensus tui, subtilitas, et omnia alia attributa augmentantur. Sumptus manae artium sensorium decrescit. Donat artem Fluxus.]

source: [Flow: Level 0/100 (0%) (Passive) Thanks to being a natural sensor, you can read the flow of mana. Increases your stability and the bonuses any movement or martial art skill provides by 1% per level in the skill.]
target: [Fluxus: Gradus 0/100 (0%) (Passivus) Gratias quod sensor naturalis es, flumen manae legere potes. Augmentat stabilitatem tuam ac beneficia cuiusque artis motoriae aut bellica per 1% per gradu praebita.]

source: Ignoring the sassy system, Sam couldn’t help the wide smile appearing on his face.
target: Systema insolentem neglexit, et Sam latum risum in facie sua effecit.

source: Getting the Natural Sensor skill was something he never expected.
target: Artem Sensoris Naturalis adeptus esse, id numquam exspectaverat.

source: In his inherited memories, the other Sam only knew one person who had that.
target: In memoria hereditata, alter Sam unam tantum personam cognoscebat, quae hoc habebat.

source: And that person was somebody who was raised by a guild of mages attempting to create the perfect mage years after the start of the game.
target: Et illa persona erat, a societate magorum educata, quae magum perfectum creare conabatur annos post initium ludi.

source: And while they bragged about the skill, they kept the details about acquiring it to themselves.
target: Et dum de hac arte se laudabant, singula de eius adeptione ad se reservabant.

source: However, getting the skill also meant something different to Sam.
target: Attamen, artem adeptio Sam quoque aliquid alium significabat.

source: The other Sam was never talented enough with mana to get even close to what Sam had achieved.
target: Alter Sam numquam satis ingenio manae utebatur, ut prope id quod Sam attigit, assequeretur.

source: He had the theoretical knowledge, of course, but he could have never done what Sam had just done.
target: Habebat scientiam theoreticam, scilicet, sed numquam potuit id quod Sam modo perfecerat.

source: This meant that Sam was different, which helped with the low‑level issue that had been simmering in the back of his mind for a long time.
target: Hoc significabat Sam esse diversum, quod opem tulit ad quaestionem parvi gradus, quae diu in mente eius insidiabatur.

source: He was different from the person he had inherited the body from.
target: Erat diversus ab illa persona, a qua corpus habuerat.

source: He wasn’t the other Sam with some memories.
target: Non erat alter Sam, qui quibusdam memoriis utebatur.

source: He was a new Sam. With memories from a particular timeline, but he wasn’t that person.
target: Novus Sam erat. Cum memoriis ex linea temporali peculiari, sed ille persona non erat.

source: It strangely helped with his sorta‑impostor syndrome that had been bubbling under the surface.
target: Id mirum modo adiuvabat in suo quasi "impostor syndrome" quod sub superficie bulliebat.

source: Sam would have to think further about it, but for now, he was somewhat reassured.
target: Sam ulterius de hoc cogitare debebat, sed nunc aliquantulum solatium inveniebat.

source: Feeling, once again, as if a slight weight had been lifted from his shoulders, he returned his attention to the rest of the screens in front of him.
target: Iterum se sentiens quasi levato parvo pondo ex umeris, animadvertit reliquas tabulas ante se.

source: [Intermediate Breathing Technique is now Level 1!]
target: [Technica Respirationis Intermedia nunc Gradus 1 est!]

source: [Calm Heart is now Level 15!]
target: [Cor Tranquillum nunc Gradus 15 est!]

source: [Multitasking is now Level 34!]
target: [Multitasking nunc Gradus 34 est!]

source: [Efficiency is now Level 6!]
target: [Efficientia nunc Gradus 6 est!]

source: [Mana Synergy is now Level 7!]
target: [Manae Synergia nunc Gradus 7 est!]

source: He was a little disappointed that Mana Well didn’t level up, but it probably needed a little more usage of mana.
target: Paulum contristatus erat quod Manae Fons non gradum ascendisset, sed verisimiliter paulum ampliorem usum manae necessitabat.

source: Thanks to his monstrous mana regeneration, he was never in danger of running out of mana.
target: Gratias regenerationi manae ingentis, numquam in periculo deficiendi manae versabatur.

source: Looking back up at the symbol high up on the tree, he directed his Mana Sense at it, marvelling at how detailed and easy it was to use.
target: Respiciens ad signum in altum in arbore situm, sensum manae suum in illud direxit, admirans quam subtiliter et facile id adhiberetur.

source: As if after looking around with bad eyes he was suddenly given prescription glasses.
target: Veluti, postquam male per oculos inspiciebat, subito oculi correctivi ei dederunt.

source: Concentrating on the faint mana signature in the symbol, he reached out and looked for the others that would lead him to his final destination.
target: Concentrans in leve signum manae in signo, manum protendit et alios quaesivit, qui eum ad ultimam destinationem perducerent.

source: Finding one, he nodded, ignored the monster’s complaint, and began calmly walking.
target: Inveniens unum, capite assensit, querelas monstri neglexit, et tranquille ambulare coepit.

source: Sam spent a better part of several hours hopping from tree to tree, following the symbols high up in the air like some kind of demented treasure hunt.
target: Sam plurimas horas arborem ex arbore saliendo consumpsit, signa in alto aere sequens, quasi insania quaesitio thesauri.

source: "I mean… it’s kinda a treasure hunt… If you squint…" he mused as he felt what was probably the last symbol.
target: "Dico... quasi quaestio thesauri est... Si oculos angulose constringas..." meditatus est, dum sensit quod probabiliter ultimum signum esset.

source: It was much bigger and held much more mana than the previous ones.
target: Iam multo maius erat et multam manam plurimam retinebat quam ea praecedentia.

source: Even the terrain was changing.
target: Etiam terra ipse mutabatur.

source: Mirroring his approach to the bandit hideout, the rocks and stone on the ground were multiplying, though here the trees weren’t thinning.
target: Saxa et lapides in terra multiplicabantur, sed arbores ibi non minuebantur.

source: Ironwood trees didn’t really care where they grew, be it plains, hills or mountainsides.
target: Arbores ligni ferrei minime curabant, ubi crescerent—sive in campis, sive in collibus aut in montium latis.

source: Navigating the still‑thick forest, he arrived in front of the last tree, marked with the biggest symbol.
target: Per silvam adhuc densa navigans, appropinquavit ad ultimam arborem, signo maximo notatam.

source: He spent a minute looking up at the symbol, raised high by the passing time, then nodded and began walking around the trunk of the tree until he stood across from a small crack in the mountainside, with an old, weathered, moss‑covered stone marked with the same symbol, though lacking the mana imbued in it.
target: Per unum minutum signum aspiciens, quod tempore extulit, deinde capite assensit et circa truncum arboris ambulare coepit, donec iuxta parvam fissuram in latere montis consedit, ad lapidem vetustum, musco opertum, eodem signo notatum, quamvis manae in eo non adfinitam esse videbatur.

source: Which made sense.
target: Quod rationem faciebat.

source: Instead of heading in immediately, he simply sought a dry spot near the crack, set up his tent, and spent a minute feeding Lucky, who spent the entire time he wandered through the forest in his shadow, patiently watching.
target: Pro eo ut statim intraret, locum siccum iuxta fissuram quaesivit, tentorium constituit, et per unam minutas Lucky pascit, qui totum tempus in silva, in umbra eius, vagabatur, attente inspiciens.

source: Sam thought that the loyal wolf deserved a little pampering.
target: Sam putavit lupo fideli parum indulgentiam mereri.

source: The cricket finally hopped off his head and began looking around the clearing curiously.
target: Demum gryllus ex capite eius descendit et in area clara, curiosus, quaerebat.

source: He just sat in front of his tent, playing with Lucky, who was on his back, tongue out and in pure bliss.
target: Ipsum coram tentorio sedebat, ludens cum Lucky, qui in dorso eius sedebat, lingua extrorsa et in pura beatitudine.

source: Finally, the cricket looking up at the giant ironwood tree with the biggest symbol spoke up.
target: Denique, gryllus aspiciens ingentem arborem ligni ferrei cum maximo signo, locutus est.

source: “Fascinating…”
target: «Fascinans…»

source: Sam just continued to pet the wolf.
target: Sam lupum teneriter fovebat.

source: “You’re supposed to ask what is fascinating, child of man!” came the pouting call from the cricket.
target: «Debes quaerere quid sit fascinans, fili hominis!» inquit gryllus, vultu contritum.

source: Sam sighed.
target: Sam suspiravit.

source: “What is fascinating, ma’am?”
target: «Quid est fascinans, domina?»

source: The cricket immediately perked up.
target: Gryllus statim excitatus est.

source: “I’m glad you asked, child of man! This mana! It is familiar!”
target: «Gaudeo quod rogavisti, fili hominis! Haec mana est mihi nota!»

source: Now that managed to raise Sam’s head.
target: Hoc efficit ut caput Sam elevaretur.

source: “Oh, how so?”
target: «O, quomodo ita?»

source: “I don’t know…” came the reply, and Sam could hear the frustration in her voice.
target: «Nescio...» inquit, et Sam audire potuit frustrationem in voce eius.

source: “If we go by tropes, she is probably the familiar of an ancient ranger or druid or protector. Or maybe the last owner of the Chalice…” he thought, but didn’t speak up.
target: «Si secundum tropos agat, fortasse illa est familiaris antiqui custodis aut druidis aut protectoris. Aut fortasse ultimus Calicis dominus...» meditavit, sed non locutus est.

source: Neither did the cricket.
target: Nec gryllus quidquam dixit.

source: Instead, it continued to hop around the crack, checking out things while Sam pampered the dog.
target: Proinde, gryllus per fissuram salire perrexit, rerum inspectione se occupans, dum Sam Lucky indulgentiam ferebat.

source: Looking up at the sky, he saw it was quickly darkening.
target: Aspiciens in caelum, vidit celeriter obscurari.

source: Nodding to himself, he set up a proper camp, then after making sure that the cricket wouldn’t eat him while sleeping, he crawled into his sleeping bag and logged out.
target: Noddans sibi, castra propria constitui, ac deinde, curavit ut gryllus eum dum dormiret non ederet, in sacco cubili se conplexus est et se ex systemate discessit.

source: The moment Sam pulled off the helmet, he rushed to the bathroom, had a quick shower then fell into his bed fast asleep, mentally and physically tired beyond belief.
target: Moxquam Sam galeam abstulit, festinavit ad balneum, cito se lavavit, deinde in lecto suo obdormivit, mente et corpore incredibiliter fessus.

source: The next morning he was still a little off, so he took his time to do his exercise routine, had a nice breakfast, watched the news and did a little cleaning.
target: Postero mane adhuc paulum perturbatus erat, ita tempus tulit ut exercitationes suas perageret, ientaculum jucundum sumpsit, nuntios spectavit et aliquantulum purgavit.

source: Then, with a heavy heart, sat down in front of his computer and began checking the news.
target: Deinde, corde gravi, coram computatro suo consedit et nuntios inspicere incipiebat.

source: The troll hunt was still ongoing.
target: Venatio trollorum adhuc pergebat.

source: The guild wars it generated dominated the news.
target: Bella collegiorum, quae illud excitaverant, nuntios dominabant.

source: Everyone wanted that skill book.
target: Omnes illum librum artium desiderabant.

source: Everyone.
target: Omnes.

source: "Hmm… that gives me an idea…"
target: «Hmm… id mihi ideam dat…»

source: Turning his attention to other news, he checked the popularity with a little trepidation, and he was rewarded by a nice statistics graphic on the game’s website that proudly proclaimed how many people are playing the game.
target: Vertens animos ad alias nuntias, parva timore popularitatem inspiciens, et remuneratus est pulchra statica graphica in situ ludi, quae superbe indicabat quot homines ludum ludere.

source: Scowling, he checked his bank account and smiled a little when he saw how much the shares he bought were worth.
target: Furibunde, rationem argentariam inspiciens, paulum subridens animadvertit quantum partium emptionum valeat.

source: "At least that’s nice…"
target: «Saltem, hoc iucundum est…»

source: Sam went through his list of important people, checking up on them on the internet.
target: Sam per indicem personarum gravium transivit, de quibus in interreti inspiciens.

source: The streamers were easy.
target: Streamers erant faciles.

source: SummerRose was gaining followers ever since he directed her towards the unique class, and other currently beginner streamers were gaining ground.
target: SummerRose secutores inveniebat, ex quo eam ad unicam classem dirigebat, atque alii streamerii incipientes progrediebantur.

source: Soon, much sooner than he expected, he would have to start networking.
target: Mox, citius quam exspectaverat, retis coniunctionem inire debebat.

source: Getting on the ground floor in this was vital to his plans.
target: Intra primum gradum implicari essentiale erat pro consiliis eius.

source: As for his enemies?
target: Quoad hostes eius?

source: He was making very detailed notes on them.
target: De eis notas plurimas et accuratas conficiebat.

source: After he was done with that, he spent a little time just spending time on the internet, still finding the new world’s internet culture fascinating.
target: Postquam id confecerat, paululum temporis tantum in interreti degit, culturam interretialem novae mundi adhuc fascinantem existimans.

source: Sadly, he had to stop, as he had a pseudo‑dungeon to run.
target: Heu, debebat cessare, nam pseudo‑caveam regere oportebat.

source: Reluctantly, he stood up from the computer and laid down and put on the helmet, ready for whatever was inside that mountain.
target: Invitus, ab computatro surrexit, se iacuit et galeam induit, paratus ad quidquid intra illam montem existimet.
